mistake_reason: At step 9, FileSurfer explicitly stated it was filtering Format = Blu-Ray and sorting by Release Year ascending, but the returned list included non-Blu-Ray entries and appears influenced by Acquisition Date and/or incorrect format classification (e.g., 'Antique Roads' with Release Year 1998, later shown as Format: DVD). This is a reasoning-action mismatch: the stated plan (Blu-Ray filter + Release Year sort) contradicts the actual action and output, leading the team to select a non-Blu-Ray title as the oldest Blu-Ray. The inconsistency triggered downstream acceptance of the wrong item despite later correct derivation of 'Time-Parking 2: Parallel Universe' as the oldest Blu-Ray.
